title: GTA6 Wait: Why Hellraiser: Revival is the Perfect AA Horror Game to Play Right Now
description: As players await GTA6 and other massive titles, Push Square explores why the 10-hour AA horror game Hellraiser: Revival makes for the ultimate gaming palate cleanser.
author: GTA6 Hub Editorial
content:
## Finding the Ideal Palate Cleanser While Waiting for GTA6

As the gaming community eagerly anticipates massive upcoming releases like GTA6 and classic experiences such as The Legend of Zelda: Ocarina of Time, many players find themselves facing a common dilemma. When you know a massive time investment is right around the corner with a title like GTA6, starting another sprawling, hundred-hour epic just doesn't feel appealing. Instead, gamers often look for well-crafted, mid-tier AA titles that offer a complete, satisfying experience without demanding weeks of dedication.

According to a recent feature by Push Square, this exact scenario led writer Liam to try out the horror game Hellraiser: Revival. Despite having never watched a single Hellraiser film before, he found himself genuinely surprised by how much fun the game was to play. For anyone looking to scratch a gaming itch while keeping their schedule flexible, this kind of focused horror release might just be the exact ticket.

## The Appeal of a 10-Hour Platinum Trophy Journey

One of the standout aspects of Hellraiser: Revival is its approachable length. For players hesitant to dive into heavy, time-consuming adventures while awaiting monumental launches like GTA6, a concise game is a welcome relief. 

Push Square noted that the entire playthrough clocks in at around 10 hours for a Platinum Trophy run. This kind of runtime hits a sweet spot: it is substantial enough to feel like a complete journey, yet short enough to be completed over a weekend or a few casual evenings. Without the overwhelming open-world bloat that characterizes many modern AAA blockbusters, players can enjoy a tightly paced horror experience from start to finish.

## AA Horror Gems in a Sea of Blockbusters

While AAA juggernauts often dominate the conversation, the AA horror space frequently delivers unique, boundary-pushing concepts. Games like Hellraiser: Revival demonstrate that you don't need a multi-million-dollar budget to deliver memorable thrills and engaging gameplay loops. For newcomers and horror veterans alike, diving into a focused narrative without the fatigue of a massive campaign can be immensely refreshing.

## Editor's Take

While the hype train for GTA6 continues to dominate our timelines, taking a break with a tight, 10-hour AA horror game like Hellraiser: Revival is a great way to avoid game fatigue. It proves that you don't need a massive time commitment to have a great gaming weekend before the next big thing arrives.
